title: KHR_character_expression_mapping glTF Document Extension
description: Defines independent mappings from native expression drivers to endpoint outputs and from endpoint commands to native expression drivers.

expressionSetMappings.description: Nonempty dictionary of native-driver-to-endpoint-output mappings. Each key is an absolute URI identifying a version-stable endpoint expression vocabulary.

additionalProperties.description: Nonempty endpoint-output dictionary. Each key is a nonempty endpoint expression identifier and each value lists native source contributions.
Nonempty array of native source contributions to this endpoint output.

items.description: Weighted contribution from one native expression driver to an endpoint output.

source.description: Index of the source expression in the top-level KHR_character_expression object.
source.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `expressions` array of the top-level `KHR_character_expression` extension object.

name.description: Diagnostic copy of the source expression label.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: When defined, this value MUST exactly and case-sensitively match the `expression` property referenced by `source`. Resolution MUST use `source`, not `name`.

weight.description: Contribution coefficient from this native expression driver to the endpoint output.

expressionSetInputMappings.description: Nonempty dictionary of endpoint-command-to-native-driver input mappings. Each key is an absolute URI identifying a version-stable endpoint expression vocabulary.

additionalProperties.description: Nonempty endpoint-command dictionary. Each key is a nonempty endpoint expression identifier and each value lists native target contributions.
Nonempty array of native target contributions from this endpoint command.

items.description: Weighted contribution from one endpoint command to a native expression driver.

target.description: Index of the target expression driver in the top-level KHR_character_expression object.
target.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the `expressions` array of the top-level `KHR_character_expression` extension object.

name.description: Diagnostic copy of the target expression label.
name.gltf_detailedDescription: When defined, this value MUST exactly and case-sensitively match the `expression` property referenced by `target`. Resolution MUST use `target`, not `name`.

weight.description: Contribution coefficient from this endpoint command to the native expression driver.
